name: Kyra
text: What the.. how is.. that even possible for an old Globe?
Kyra asks, but then she decided to not overthink much about it and continue to write the rest down.

name: Kyra
text: And.. Marked… right.. here. These coordinates… they’re deliberate. Someone’s been tracking something... or someone. But what, who, why? What’s the purpose of this obsession?
